name: Mercantile On Main
summary: Mercantile On Main is a boutique shopping destination in historic downtown Farmersville, Texas, featuring a curated selection of retail experiences. With a perfect 5-star rating, this Main Street property offers visitors a charming small-town shopping atmosphere in the heart of Collin County.
demographics: Mercantile On Main serves the Farmersville community and surrounding Collin County area, attracting primarily middle-income families and retirees drawn to small-town Texas living. The trade area encompasses both local residents seeking unique shopping experiences and visitors exploring the historic downtown district, with a customer base that values personalized service and community-oriented retail. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for boutique offerings and specialty goods rather than big-box retail, with visitors typically ranging from young families to older adults who appreciate the center's authentic small-town character and Main Street location.
description: Mercantile On Main is a charming shopping destination located in the heart of historic downtown Farmersville, Texas at 111 South Main Street. This boutique retail center embodies small-town Texas charm while offering visitors a curated selection of unique shopping experiences. With its prime location on Main Street, the center serves as a community gathering place that celebrates local commerce and heritage. The property maintains excellent customer satisfaction, reflected in its perfect 5-star rating from visitors who appreciate its personalized service and distinctive character. Open daily from 10 AM to 5 PM, Mercantile On Main provides a welcoming atmosphere for both locals and visitors exploring the historic downtown district of this Collin County community.
